Name: Jodi Who Used To Be an Idol ENG
Author: Doorublob
Description:
A translation of Idol Jodi by the lovely luoli!!!

I love luoli's work, and I hope they'll make many more expansions on vanilla npcs- They make them fresh and new to interact with!

(NOTE: I am not a native Chinese speaker, and this mod is mainly me cleaning up a machine translation. I am having a few native Chinese speakers look over what I wrote, however, so hopefully it's fairly accurate.)

Original Chinese mod- https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10492
